entries.title: Proverbs 6:1
segments: ¶My son, if you have made yourself responsible for your neighbour, or given your word for another,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:2
segments: You are taken as in a net by the words of your mouth, the sayings of your lips have overcome you.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:3
segments: Do this, my son, and make yourself free, because you have come into the power of your neighbour; go without waiting, and make a strong request to your neighbour.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:4
segments: Give no sleep to your eyes, or rest to them;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:5
segments: Make yourself free, like the roe from the hand of the archer, and the bird from him who puts a net for her.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:6
segments: ¶Go to the ant, you hater of work; give thought to her ways and be wise:

entries.title: Proverbs 6:7
segments: Having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:8
segments: She gets her meat in the summer, storing up food at the time of the grain-cutting.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:9
segments: How long will you be sleeping, O hater of work? when will you get up from your sleep?

entries.title: Proverbs 6:10
segments: A little sleep, a little rest, a little folding of the hands in sleep:

entries.title: Proverbs 6:11
segments: Then loss will come on you like an outlaw, and your need like an armed man

entries.title: Proverbs 6:12
segments: ¶A good-for-nothing man is an evil-doer; he goes on his way causing trouble with false words;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:13
segments: Making signs with his eyes, rubbing with his feet, and giving news with his fingers;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:14
segments: His mind is ever designing evil: he lets loose violent acts.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:15
segments: For this cause his downfall will be sudden; quickly he will be broken, and there will be no help for him.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:16
segments: Six things are hated by the Lord; seven things are disgusting to him:

entries.title: Proverbs 6:17
segments: Eyes of pride, a false tongue, hands which take life without cause;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:18
segments: A heart full of evil designs, feet which are quick in running after sin;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:19
segments: A false witness, breathing out untrue words, and one who lets loose violent acts among brothers.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:20
segments: ¶My son, keep the rule of your father, and have in memory the teaching of your mother:

entries.title: Proverbs 6:21
segments: Keep them ever folded in your heart, and have them hanging round your neck.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:22
segments: In your walking, it will be your guide; when you are sleeping, it will keep watch over you; when you are awake, it will have talk with you.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:23
segments: For the rule is a light, and the teaching a shining light; and the guiding words of training are the way of life.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:24
segments: They will keep you from the evil woman, from the smooth tongue of the strange woman.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:25
segments: Let not your heart's desire go after her fair body; let not her eyes take you prisoner.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:26
segments: For a loose woman is looking for a cake of bread, but another man's wife goes after one's very life.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:27
segments: May a man take fire to his breast without burning his clothing?

entries.title: Proverbs 6:28
segments: Or may one go on lighted coals, and his feet not be burned?

entries.title: Proverbs 6:29
segments: So it is with him who goes in to his neighbour's wife; he who has anything to do with her will not go free from punishment.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:30
segments: Men do not have a low opinion of a thief who takes food when he is in need of it:

entries.title: Proverbs 6:31
segments: But if he is taken in the act he will have to give back seven times as much, giving up all his property which is in his house.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:32
segments: He who takes another man's wife is without all sense: he who does it is the cause of destruction to his soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:33
segments: Wounds will be his and loss of honour, and his shame may not be washed away.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:34
segments: For bitter is the wrath of an angry husband; in the day of punishment he will have no mercy.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:35
segments: He will not take any payment; and he will not make peace with you though your money offerings are increased.
